changelog.title: EC-Council CSE Module 01
changelog.description: Complete Cloud Security Essentials Module 01 with presentation (24 slides), terminal-based lab (12 CLI commands), and quiz (18 questions).

changelog.title: Terminal-Based Labs
changelog.description: Labs now use terminal CLI interfaces where students type commands and receive educational output. Matches cloud-lab-simulator pattern.

changelog.title: 100% Certification Mapping
changelog.description: All 529 content items now mapped to certification paths. Filter by CompTIA A+, Security+, Network+, Linux+, AWS CCP, CCNA, and 11 more paths.

changelog.title: 17 Certification Paths
changelog.description: Content mapped across: CompTIA (A+, Security+, Network+, Linux+), AWS CCP, Azure Fundamentals, CCNA, Python, DevOps, and specialized tracks.

changelog.title: Multi-Filter Search
changelog.description: EXPLORE ALL now has four filter dropdowns: Certification, House, Type, and Difficulty. Combine any filters with AND logic to find exactly what you need.

changelog.title: House Filter
changelog.description: Filter content by originating house (Web, Shield, Cloud, Forge, Script, Code, Key, Eye). See all modules from your favorite house.

changelog.title: Type Filter
changelog.description: Filter by content type: presentation, lab, quiz, or applet. Focus on the learning format that works best for you.

changelog.title: Difficulty Filter
changelog.description: Filter by difficulty level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced. Match content to your skill level.

changelog.title: Matrix Terminal Tabs
changelog.description: Operator terminal now has three tabs: PROGRAMS (house access), SKILL TREE (FF7-inspired navigation), and EXPLORE ALL (search everything). Switch via click or command line.

changelog.title: Operator Skill Tree
changelog.description: Matrix users now have access to the FF7-inspired skill tree with three perspectives: Fundamentals (know), Tools (use), and Skills (do). Full parity with Factionless path.

changelog.title: Content Search
changelog.description: New EXPLORE ALL tab lets you search across all content. Relevance-ranked results with instant preview. Type to filter, click to navigate.

changelog.title: Certification Filter
changelog.description: Filter content by certification path (CompTIA A+, Security+, AWS CCP, etc.). Combine with keyword search to find exactly what you need.

changelog.title: Mobile Touch Fix
changelog.description: Fixed mobile browser issues - scrolling and button clicks now work properly while fireflies still react to your touch.

changelog.title: Caller Tracing
changelog.description: Audit tool now traces function callers. Instead of 'Unknown coming soon at line 1212', you see 'DevOps Fundamentals calls openPath()'. Know exactly what to fix.

changelog.title: Debug Toggle
changelog.description: Add ?debug=true to audit tool URL for verbose logging. Silent by default, detailed when you need it.

changelog.title: Audit Fix Locations
changelog.description: Audit tool now shows exactly where to fix each issue: file path, diagnosis, and specific action. No more searching for problems.

changelog.title: Testing Pyramid Definitions
changelog.description: Added beginner-friendly explanations for E2E, Integration, and Unit tests with examples and tool recommendations.

changelog.title: Lab Immersive Mode
changelog.description: Unit Testing lab now uses full-screen focus mode. Click a challenge to enter, results appear as popups with confetti celebrations.

changelog.title: Unit Testing Module
changelog.description: Complete Unit Testing learning module with presentation (AAA pattern, TDD, mocking, coverage), interactive lab with live code editor, and 12-question quiz.

changelog.title: Incomplete Content Audit
changelog.description: New audit option tracks coming-soon modules, placeholder learning paths, and missing files. Real accountability for what's incomplete.

changelog.title: Lean Exports
changelog.description: Audit exports now only include problems, not synced/passed items. Reduces file size from ~59K tokens to ~2K tokens.

changelog.title: Audit Tool: Module-Level Diagnostics
changelog.description: Fix Forge now reports exactly which modules are missing the category field, not just which house. Makes debugging easier.

changelog.title: Houses Fixed (Forge, Code, Key)
changelog.description: Applied category-based filtering to Forge, Code, and Key houses. All modules now have category fields for proper filtering.

changelog.title: Category-Based Fixes
changelog.description: Fix Forge now recommends category-based filtering (better than path-based). Modules declare their category, not limited by folder structure.

changelog.title: Fix Forge
changelog.description: New audit tool feature generates copyable code fixes. Living KBA that diagnoses issues and provides ready-to-paste solutions.

changelog.title: Eye House Fixed
changelog.description: Category filtering and certification paths now work correctly. Modules filter by category instead of broken path matching.

changelog.title: Structural Audit Added
changelog.description: Audit tool now detects broken category paths, placeholder functions, and coming-soon modules. Found via Eye house investigation.

changelog.title: Content Audit Tool
changelog.description: New admin tool to audit content sync between SAMPLE_MODULES and ContentRegistry. Find mismatches before they break!

changelog.title: CMMC Content Fixed
changelog.description: All 17 CMMC compliance modules now load correctly from CloudFront CDN with full presentation data.

changelog.title: Interactive Labs Added
changelog.description: Cyber Arts Bootcamp now includes 5 hands-on labs with mission-based terminal exercises. Learn by doing!
